notes: Documentation-only. 2026-11-15 correction (owner): the pressure-sensitive cloth has 12 electrodes, not a 6x6 scanned matrix. No GPIO column excitation, no HI_Z, no 36-point scan. Electrode-to-ADC/AIN mapping is PENDING_REAL_WIRING; do not fill or guess any ADC/AIN numbers before the real wiring record. ADC1-3 CS/MISO pairings confirmed by user from new wiring diagram; ADC4 is planned, not built. Update legacy firmware pin map and verify SPI before reporting hardware PASS.
